Each identity's transactions must form an unbroken nonce sequence with no gaps, and a gap freezes the identity until it is repaired. Cloning a key into 12 hands breaks the sequence because two signers race the same nonce, as a result a shared-credential farm convicts itself on the first collision. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
